reviews.comment:
Hace más de 30 años que mi esposa y yo somos socios, tenemos los autos asegurados en el ACA, Nos ofrecen la opción de sport club, como adultos mayores vamos en vehículo, Lo dejamos en el estacionamiento, siempre avisamos, un día nos persiguieron para pedirnos que no dejemos más el vehículo, vino el supervisor, el gerente y la guardia, con un maltrato jamás recibido. Mande mails y jamás fueron contestados, una vergüenza, trato discriminatorio ya que vemos que gente por solo ir sin ser socio no se le cuestiona el estacionamiento.

(Translated by Google)
My wife and I have been members for over 30 years, and our cars are insured with the ACA. They offer us the sports club option, and as senior citizens, we drive. We always leave our cars in the parking lot, and we always notify them. One day, they chased us down and demanded we stop leaving our car there. The supervisor, the manager, and the security guard came, and we were treated with a level of mistreatment I've never experienced before. I sent emails, and they were never answered. It's a disgrace; it's discriminatory treatment, since we see that people who aren't members aren't questioned about parking there.
